issues.title: Unable to change Welcome Image
issues.body:
From the `Welcome` tab of the admin pages, the Game Designer can change the welcome image logo:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/174037264-cdf864d4-e305-4f75-9533-64cb6f1b963c.png)


When I try to add an SVG or PNG image, I get this error in the node console:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/174037059-4c56af85-1762-41e1-8686-951dafd85fb8.png)
